sections.Profile:
Pit Stop , released by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in 1968, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Christian Marche. With a car racing theme, this two-player game features a unique lap-scoring system where players accumulate laps using separate two-reel displays.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Racing, Sports, Original Theme, Cars, Single level playfield
